takes.title: Dance with Repeated Turns and Alternating High Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps and turns repeatedly, extending one arm upward while the other sweeps across or outward. They finish with the knees bent and one hand still raised.

takes.title: Dance Lambada Steps with a Raised Hand
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeats narrow side-to-side steps with bent knees and one hand near the head. The final step carries the weight outward with both forearms still lifted.

takes.title: Mime a Genie with Broad Arm Sweeps and Bows
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms, alternates raised elbows and wide reaches, and folds forward several times. They finish upright with the hands lifted beside the shoulders.

takes.title: Walk Forward with Relaxed Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a narrow stance, takes even forward steps with relaxed arm swings, and continues through the final frame.

takes.title: Mime a Hummingbird with Compact Elbow Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds the elbows away from the torso and repeats compact forearm motions with small weight shifts. They lower the arms to finish.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Small Chest-Level Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer stands with feet apart, repeats compact hand and elbow motions, and briefly dips forward. The final pose is staggered with both arms still in front.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Wide Arms and Forward Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates deep forward bends and broad arm openings while stepping from side to side. One arm remains extended in the last pose.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Wide Steps and Low Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes repeated wide, bent-knee steps, alternating downward reaches and a hand near the head. They rise into a wide stance at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Overhead Reaches and Deep Crouches
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with bent knees, steps into repeated overhead reaches, then folds forward into a compact crouch. They rise to a wide stance.

takes.title: Mime a Hummingbird with Alternating Side Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms spread, reduces the reach to smaller arm movements at chest height, and lowers both arms to stand.

takes.title: Alternate Wide Steps with Open-Hand Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly steps into a wide stance, brings both hands forward or beside the shoulders, and finishes with the hands lifted. The CMU source describes an animal mime.

takes.title: Mime a Dancing Bear with Wide Rocking Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates broad steps and turns with bent-elbow gestures, briefly lifts a foot, and finishes standing with open hands in front.

takes.title: Mime a Praying Mantis with Angular Reaches and Long Holds
takes.actionDescription: The performer changes between wide bent-knee poses and one-handed reaches, holding several positions before resuming. The take ends wide with one hand forward.

takes.title: Mime a Prairie Dog with Raised Hands and Low Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts both hands close to the face, turns and briefly sinks into a lower stance, then returns upright with the hands still raised.

takes.title: Mime a Roadrunner with Forward-Leaning Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates short forward-leaning steps and upright resets with the arms kept close, then steps into a narrow finish.

takes.title: Mime a Panda from a Sustained Low Seated Pose
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a low seated-looking position throughout, moving the hands from the chest out to the sides and back. The final pose stays low.

takes.title: Mime a Ghost with Wide Diagonal Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps and leans between broad arm reaches, including one arm high and the other low. They finish bent forward with one hand extended.

takes.title: Mime a Penguin with Narrow Steps and Small Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes narrow steps and repeatedly changes heading with low arms and slight elbow movement. The take ends upright facing away.

takes.title: Mime a Dragon with Wide Arms and Weight Shifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms spread, repeatedly sinks and rises through wide stances, and opens the palms as the arms lift. The take ends with both arms still out.

takes.title: Perform a Ballerina Pantomime with Wide Arm Positions
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens the arms, takes small crossing steps, raises both arms overhead, and lowers them into a wide finish. The CMU source identifies a hippo ballerina.

takes.title: Mime a Pterosaur with Low Wing-Like Arm Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates turns and small steps with both arms extended low and to the sides. They finish upright with both forearms still open.

takes.title: Alternate Forward Reaches with Low Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates upright pauses, extended arm gestures, and low steps or crouches. The CMU source identifies a superhero mime.

takes.title: Repeat Pointed Arm Gestures and Raise Both Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer extends an arm to the side, turns and dips, then brings both hands near or above the head. The final pose keeps both arms raised.

takes.title: Shift from Low Animal Poses to Standing Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins in a low wide crouch, alternates compact hand gestures and lower poses, then rises into wider arm movements and a short stepping finish.

takes.title: Mime a Dancing Animal with Wide Side Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates bent-knee side steps and raised elbows before drawing the arms lower. They finish upright with feet apart.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Overhead Arms and Forward Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly raises one or both arms, turns through profile, and folds forward with bent knees. The last pose returns upright with the arms lower.

takes.title: Mime a Dancing Ant with Short Bouncy Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes short bent-knee steps and turns, alternately putting hands near the hips and spreading the elbows. They finish upright with both arms low.

takes.title: Shift Between Low Crouches and High Two-Arm Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens bent low, alternates broad steps and open-handed gestures, and briefly raises both arms overhead before stepping out. The CMU source names monkey and bear pantomimes.
